shell.noFileBody: Pick a file from the sidebar to start.
shell.vaultsLoadFailed: The vault list could not be loaded.
shell.notFoundBody: This address does not lead anywhere.

pwa.offline: You are offline. Saved parts of the app still work.

files.empty: This vault has no files yet.
files.emptyHint: Create a note, or drop files here.
files.nameInvalid: That name cannot be used. Avoid / \ : * ? " < > | and names that end with a dot or a space.
files.deleteFileBody: The file is removed from the vault. It stays in the version history.
files.deleteFolderBody: The folder and everything inside it are removed from the vault. They stay in the version history.
files.importSkipped: {count, plural, one {# file was skipped} other {# files were skipped}}: only text files can be imported for now.
files.importFailed: {count, plural, one {# file could not be imported} other {# files could not be imported}}.

workspace.noPreview: There is no preview for this kind of file yet.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Type to search the names and text of notes, canvases and databases.

history.title: History
history.restoreBody: The note will go back to the version by {author} from {when}. What is there now stays in the history, so you can return to it.
history.checkpointHint: A checkpoint marks the vault as it is now, so you can find your way back to it.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.none: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
proposals.noneAtAll: No one has proposed a change yet.
proposals.staleHelp: A note changed after this was proposed, so those changes cannot be accepted any more. You can still reject them, and ask for a new proposal.
proposals.viewOnly: You can read this proposal, but accepting or rejecting changes needs the review permission.
proposals.selectAll: Select all that can be accepted
proposals.blockedHelp: Changes in a note that has changed since cannot be accepted. Reject them instead.

editor.embedFailed: This note could not be loaded
editor.conflict: Someone else saved this note first. Your text has not been saved.
editor.peers: {count, plural, one {# person here} other {# people here}}

notice.recovered: Unsent text from earlier was restored

auth.loginIntro: Use the account your administrator made for you.
auth.displayNameHint: Shown to others. Leave empty to use the username.
auth.noAccountHint: No account yet? Ask an administrator for an invite link.

setup.title: Set up Palimvo
setup.welcomeIntro: Three short steps: choose a language, create the administrator account, and make the first vault.
setup.codeHint: The server printed it in its log and saved it in the file setup-token in its data folder.
setup.localNote: You are on the same machine as the server, so no setup code is needed.
setup.accountIntro: This account can manage everything on this server. You can add more people later.
setup.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.vaultIntro: A vault is a folder of notes, canvases and databases that people and AIs share.
setup.vaultHint: Letters, digits, dash and underscore; up to 64 characters.
setup.vaultInvalid: Use letters, digits, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or digit.

invite.title: Join Palimvo
invite.intro: You were invited. Choose how you will sign in.

settings.passwordNote: Other devices are signed out when you change your password.

users.title: People
users.inviteReady: Send this link to the person. They choose their own username and password.
users.inviteOnce: The link works once and cannot be shown again. If you lose it, make a new one.
users.inviteNoteHint: Only you and other administrators see this.
users.deleteBody: {name} will be removed and signed out. Their edits stay in the history.
users.resetBody: {name} will be signed out everywhere and get a temporary password.
users.resetDoneNote: It is shown only now. They should change it after signing in.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.removedNote: Removed vaults are kept aside and can be brought back.
vaults.removeBody: The vault disappears for everyone. Its files and history are kept aside, and a server administrator can restore it.
vaults.nothingToManage: You have nothing to manage in this vault.

members.title: Members
members.note: People who can open this vault. Their permissions come from the position below and from their roles.
members.removeBody: {name} will no longer be able to open this vault.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role has a name, a colour and a rank. It can give server-wide permissions, and it can be allowed or denied things in each vault. A role can only be changed by someone whose own highest role ranks above it.
roles.name: Name
roles.joinDeny: Denied when someone joins a vault
roles.joinDenyNote: Whoever holds this role gets these permissions denied in every vault they are added to. The "Reader" role works this way.
roles.everyoneMembers: Everyone with an account has this role.
roles.locked: This role ranks at or above your own, so you can look at it but not change it.
roles.deleteBody: People who have the role {name} lose it, and any rules that mention it are removed.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: What each role and person may do in this vault. Server administrators and this vault's administrators can always open this page, and administrators cannot be locked out of it.
permissions.vaultNote: These rules apply to the whole vault. A denial beats an allowance, and a rule for a person beats a rule for a role.
permissions.folderNote: Only writing can be limited per folder. The rules apply to this folder and everything inside it; the closest folder wins.
permissions.noOverrides: No rules here yet. Add a role or a person to start.
permissions.addRole: Add a rule for a role
permissions.addPerson: Add a rule for a person
permissions.viewAsNote: See what a role (as an ordinary member) or a person can do here, with all the rules applied.
permissions.foldersNote: Writing, deleting, uploading and reviewing can be set per folder. Reading is decided for the whole vault; keep secrets in a separate vault.
permissions.noFolders: No folder has its own rules yet. Right-click a folder in the file tree and choose Permissions, or type its path below.
permissions.folderInvalid: That is not a valid folder path.

hints.roles_manage: Create roles and give them to people, below your own rank.
hints.vaults_create: Make new vaults and become their administrator.
hints.library_publish: Add plugins to the server library.
hints.audit_view: See who changed what on the server.
hints.vault_view: Open the vault and see that it exists.
hints.note_write: Create and edit notes, canvases and databases.
hints.history_view: Browse earlier versions and who made them.
hints.proposal_create: Suggest edits for others to accept.
hints.plugin_approve: Allow a plugin version to run.
hints.public_manage: Make parts of the vault public.

public.title: Public access
public.note: Visitors who are not signed in can read what is listed here. Everything else stays private.
public.hint: One path per line. Use / for the whole vault, or a folder or note path. Hidden folders are never public.

oauth.signInIntro: Sign in to Palimvo to decide whether {client} may connect.
oauth.clientWants: {client} wants to connect to your Palimvo account.
oauth.unverified: Palimvo cannot verify this app. Continue only if you started this connection yourself.
oauth.redirectsTo: After you decide, you will be sent back to {host}.
oauth.canDo: It will act as you in every vault where you may connect AI. It can never do more than you can, and it loses rights the moment yours are reduced.
oauth.revokeHint: You can disconnect it at any time under your AI connections.
oauth.adminOption: Also allow this app to administer the server
oauth.adminHint: Lets it create vaults and publish plugins to the library, and, in vaults where you may change settings, move a vault to the trash (you can restore it). It can never manage accounts, roles, keys or the audit log. Needs "Read and write".
oauth.errorTitle: This connection could not be started
oauth.errorClient: The app that sent you here is not registered, or its return address does not match.
oauth.errorRequest: The connection request is incomplete or uses something Palimvo does not support.
oauth.errorNoVaults: You are not allowed to connect AI to any vault.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.schema_invalid: The stored data has an invalid format.
errors.weak_password: The password must be 10 to 256 characters.
errors.csrf_invalid: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invite_invalid: This invite link is not valid or has expired.
errors.invalid_credentials: The name or password is wrong.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.token_scope_denied: This token does not cover that vault or folder.
errors.propose_only: This token can only propose changes.
errors.plugin_not_approved: This plugin version has not been approved.
errors.not_found: That item could not be found.
errors.already_exists: Something with that name already exists.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this file. Reload and try again.
errors.schema_too_new: The data was written by a newer version of Palimvo.
errors.vault_busy: The vault is busy with another operation. Try again in a moment.
errors.unsupported_type: That file type is not accepted.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.git_unavailable: Git is not available on the server.
errors.invalid_backup_remote: That backup location is not valid.
errors.invalid_tag: That is not a usable checkpoint name.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.public_url_required: OAuth needs the server's public address. Ask an administrator to set PALIMVO_PUBLIC_URL.
errors.proposal_stale: A note changed after this was proposed, so the change cannot be applied.
errors.proposal_changed: This proposal changed or was already decided. Reload it and try again.
